correctness.rationale: Hoang–Shimada supplies three rational A3 points and 49 F9-defined spanning divisor classes on a K3 resolution. The exhaustive finite tests give 19 quartic F3 points by 40 projective representatives and independently by 13 base fibers. The three non-split chains replace 3 points by 3 copies of P1(F3), giving 28. Frobenius squared acts as 9 on 22-dimensional H2, forcing eigenvalues ±3; Lefschetz fixes multiplicities 14 and 8. Over F9 independent 820-point and 91-fiber enumerations give 199 singular-surface points, yielding 280 after 3 split A3 chains, matching the predicted trace 22·9. CHECK.py executed with VERIFY_OK. Geometric spanning theorem is cited, not spuriously claimed computer-verified.

value.rationale: The zeta function and rational Picard rank are canonical arithmetic invariants of a natural, previously studied supersingular K3 model. Unlike the geometric isomorphism class, they distinguish the prime-field Ballico–Hefez form (rank 14) from Schütt’s rank-21 form. One explicit point count combined with a geometric cohomology-spanning theorem determines every extension-field point count, a complete natural invariant rather than an arbitrary bounded table.
